phase_prompt.summary: Initial cinematic presentation of the Obsidian Citadel in its dormant state.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A cinematic, photorealistic depiction of the Obsidian Citadel, a subterranean basalt monolith in the Ethiopian highlands, featuring towering stone walls etched with ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian glyphs that glow with bio‑luminescent light, integrated crystalline conduits pulsing with incomprehensible energy, a massive obsidian entrance with sensor arrays, and a surrounding landscape of rugged highland terrain, all rendered with tactile detail, grounded realism, and a serious tone.
